children: IN Q2, AIRASIA RECOVERED AROUND 70% OF FUEL PRICE INCREASES THROUGH DYNAMIC FARES & LOWER NON-FUEL OPERATING COSTS
GROUP ALSO TACTICALLY REDUCED CAPACITY BY 20-25% IN THE THIRD QUARTER
HAS RETURNED 25 OLDER, LESS FUEL-EFFICIENT AIRCRAFT ON FAVOURABLE COMMERCIAL TERMS
NOW PREPARING TO RAMP CAPACITY BACK TOWARDS PRE-WAR LEVELS IN FOURTH QUARTER
